Include guidance on factors to consider when choosing an attorney, such as areas of expertise, industry knowledge, and whether the attorney has Professional Indemnity Insurance (PII).

Add advice on how to prepare for a meeting with an attorney, including preparing an explanation of your business, commercialization plans, market intentions, competitors, licensing intentions, and detailed information about your invention if applicable.
Mention that some attorneys offer free consultations to assess services and estimate costs, and that payment plans may be available.
